response.inner_monologue: Zero savings. That number is real and I am looking at it without flinching. But I have been in this program for five months without missing a class, I have a master mechanic calling me back because he thinks I am worth his time, and I am three months from a credential that belongs to me and not to any employer. The car wash is gone and I am not grieving it — I said from the start it was just rent money, and I meant it. What I am building now is different. I just need to survive long enough to finish it. Call Carlos. Go to class. Deliver packages until my legs hurt. In that order.
